searched.title: Hotend Expansion Kit (store page)
searched.note: Parsed with the package (extractPage + buildImportPayload, format legacy_html, route-derived productType "accessory"; the manifest says "hotend"). The page has no specification table, no In the Box list, no weight or size and no document file list (productFileList null). Option groups: Printer Model "H2 Series/P2S/X2D", Flow Type "Standard Flow", Size "0.2mm + 0.6mm + 0.8mm", one variant. Two description tables: (1) "Comparison of Different Nozzle Sizes" (usage prose per size, including a 0.4 mm column the kit does not contain): not a spec. (2) "Filament Compatibility" (39 filaments × 0.2 mm Stainless Steel / 0.4 mm / 0.6 mm / 0.8 mm Hardened Steel): its header gives nozzle.material for the kit's three sizes, and a filament relation is written only where the kit's three columns agree (11 all √, none all X). 28 rows are mixed across the kit's nozzles (for example PLA Silk+ (√/Not recommended/Not recommended), PLA Silk Dual Color (√/Not recommended/Not recommended), PLA Silk (√/Not recommended/Not recommended)) or "Not recommended" and get no relation. The kit's three diameters cannot be held by the single-number nozzle.diameter key, so they stay in the Size value text. The notes under the table ("prone to clog a 0.2 mm nozzle" …) are usage advice, not a spec.

searched.title: Introduction to Bambu Nozzles | Bambu Lab Wiki
searched.note: Read in full from the cached HTML (the cached .txt omits the tab panels). The "H2 Series/P2S/X2D Nozzle" panel ("Max. Printing Temp: 350 ℃ | Size: 0.2mm/ 0.4mm/ 0.6mm/ 0.8mm | Materials: Hardened steel / Stainless steel") carries this kit's own printer value as its name but does not name the kit. Its layer-height table is general guidance per nozzle size for every Bambu nozzle and cannot be scoped to one of the kit's three hotends (one option value); not stored. Its High Flow sentence ("increases the maximum volume velocity by 62.5%") is about the High Flow nozzle and is marketing; this kit is Standard Flow. It states no dimensions, weight, filament diameter, flow rate or electrical value.

searched.title: Filament guide - Printer, Nozzle, AMS, Build Plate, Glue Compatibility and Required Parameters | Bambu Lab Wiki
searched.note: Linked from the store page ("Learn more about filament compatibility on Bambu Lab Wiki"). A general guide for every Bambu nozzle (columns 0.2/0.4/0.6/0.8 mm and 0.4/0.6/0.8 mm High flow), so none of its rows is stored as a spec of this kit; it is used only to flag disagreements with this page's Filament Compatibility table on the relations written (PC and PC FR at 0.2 mm; the X2D auxiliary-hotend qualifier on ABS at 0.2 mm). Its nozzle temperatures are per filament, not the hotend's maximum; its 0.4 mm advice is for a size this kit does not contain. It states no filament diameter and no flow rate.

The wiki does not name this kit (its purchase link is "Bambu Hotend - H2/P2S Standard & High Flow"), so the value stays unverified. The store page states no maximum temperature. In range (150–350 °C).

specs.value: 0.2 mm: Stainless Steel; 0.6 mm: Hardened Steel; 0.8 mm: Hardened Steel
specs.locator: Filament Compatibility › header row › columns 1, 3 and 4 (the sizes of Option group "Size" › value 1)
specs.quote: Filament | 0.2 mm Stainless Steel | 0.4 mm Hardened Steel | 0.6 mm Hardened Steel | 0.8 mm Hardened Steel
specs.note: The page's Filament Compatibility header gives each nozzle size its material; the kit holds 0.2, 0.6 and 0.8 mm ("Size: 0.2mm + 0.6mm + 0.8mm"), so the 0.4 mm column is not part of it. The wiki panel agrees ("Materials: Hardened steel / Stainless steel"). The store page has no row for this key (the Size group is kind "size", not "nozzle"), so nothing conflicts.

The value text names one hotend of each size without a multiplier ("0.2mm" + "0.6mm" + "0.8mm"), read as 1 + 1 + 1 = 3; the product subtitle says the same sizes ("Expand beyond the standard 0.4 mm hotend with 0.2 mm, 0.6 mm, and 0.8 mm options"). No count is printed and there is no In the Box list, so the count stays unverified.
